blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Estimating the metric 3D position of people from a monocular camera is important for robot navigation and motion prediction. Lightweight pose-based localizers are attractive for robotic hardware with limited computational resources because they operate on compact 2D keypoints. However, they typically discard the richer visual representations computed by the pose estimator. We introduce MoSoLoco, a per-frame monocular 3D human localizer that combines the pose detector's internal visual features with the detected 2D skeleton, without requiring an additional RGB or depth encoder. MoSoLoco can further incorporate sparse same-frame multi-person context to refine individual position estimates. Experiments on JRDB and NuScenes show that reusing pose-detector representations improves localization, reducing the best JRDB error by approximately 23 percent relative to the strongest evaluated keypoint-based baseline. A sparse social-interaction module incorporates nearby detections from the same image for further refinement. Controlled trajectory-forecasting experiments show downstream benefits, while the complete pipeline remains suitable for efficient Jetson AGX Xavier inference.
blocks.zh: 从单相机中估计人们的度量3D位置对机器人导航和运动预测很重要. 轻量级姿势本地化器对计算资源有限的机器人硬件具有吸引力,因为它们在紧凑的2D键点上运行. 然而,它们通常放弃了由姿势估计者计算的更丰富的视觉表现。 我们引入了MoSoLoco,一种每帧单相单相的3D人本地化器,它结合了姿势探测器的内部视觉特征和被探测到的2D骨架,而不需要额外的RGB或深度编码. MoSoLoco可以进一步纳入稀疏的同框多人背景,来完善单个位置估计. 对JRDB和NuScens的实验表明,重新使用姿势探测器的表示可以改善本地化,相对于最强的经评价的以关键点为基础的基线,JRDB最佳出错减少约23%. 一个稀少的社会互动模块包含来自同一图像的相邻检测,以作进一步完善。 所控制的轨迹预测实验显示出下游的好处,而完整的管道仍然适合高效的Jetson AGX Xavier推断.

blocks.en: Robots operating around people can benefit from real-world 3D human positions for navigation, interaction, and motion prediction [ 5 , schmerling2018multimodal , xu2024towards ] . Monocular cameras are attractive for compact systems, but perspective projection provides no direct metric depth. One solution is to add a depth sensor such as LiDAR, which increases hardware cost and system complexity; another is to use large monocular depth models such as UniDepth V2 [ 6 ] , which provide depth understanding at a considerable computational cost. A pose estimator already provides a compact representation of each person and can support tasks beyond pose estimation, such as pedestrian intention prediction [ 8 ] . This motivates us to ask: can computation already performed for human pose estimation also support metric 3D localization?
blocks.zh: 围绕人运行的机器人可以从真实世界的3D人类位置得到导航,互动,以及运动预测[5,schmerling2018多模式,xu2024 towards]. 单相机对紧凑的系统具有吸引力,但视角投影不能提供直接的度量深度. 一个解决方案是增加LiDAR等深度传感器,这增加了硬件成本和系统复杂度;另一个解决方案是使用Uni Depth V2 [6]等大型单元深度模型,以相当大的计算成本提供深度理解. 姿势估计器已经为每个人提供了紧凑的表述,并且可以支持超出姿势估计的任务,例如行人意图预测 [8]. 这促使我们问:已经为人类布局估计进行的计算能否也支持计量3D本地化?

blocks.en:
Pose-based localizers estimate 3D person positions from 2D pose detections. MonoLoco [ bertoni2019monoloco ] uses camera-normalized skeletons, while MonoTransmotion [ luan2025unified ] adds temporal pose observations. In these approaches, localization relies mainly on the final keypoints, even though the detector computes richer visual representations before producing them. Similarly, trajectory-forecasting methods model interactions among nearby people [ alahi2016social , saadatnejad2024socialtransmotion ] , whereas pose-based localizers have generally focused on the target person and temporal observations rather than same-frame spatial context. These observations point to two underused sources of localization information: intermediate detector features
and neighboring detections.

blocks.en:
The study proceeds in two stages. First, a controlled feature probe tests whether frozen pose-detector representations retain camera-depth information beyond coarse skeleton-derived cues. These observations motivate MoSoLoco , a per-frame monocular 3D human localizer that estimates each person’s 3D position from the detector’s visual
representations and the detected 2D skeleton expressed in camera coordinates, as illustrated in Fig. . The pose detector remains frozen, so no additional RGB or depth encoder is required. Two localizer designs are considered: a lightweight MLP-based model and a more expressive Transformer-based model. For multi-person scenes, the model can optionally use sparse attention over nearby detections from the same image. This module uses neither identities nor observations from previous frames, allowing the contributions of detector representations and same-frame spatial context
to be evaluated independently.

blocks.en: We evaluate the method on JRDB [ martin2021jrdb ] and NuScenes [ 2 ] . The experiments separate the effects of skeleton geometry, pose-detector representations, fusion architecture, detector capacity, and same-frame multi-person context. We also evaluate the estimated coordinates as observations for fixed trajectory forecasters, following the view that errors in real perception inputs can propagate to downstream motion prediction [ xu2024towards ] . Finally, we measure detector–localizer inference on an embedded robotic platform.
blocks.zh: 我们评价JRDB[martin2021jrdb]和NuScens[2]的方法. 实验将骨架几何,姿势探测器表现,聚变结构,探测器能力,同帧多人上下文的作用分开. 我们还将估计坐标作为固定轨迹预测器的观测数据来评价,因为实际感知输入的错误可以传播到下游运动预测[xu2024 towards]. 最后,我们测量一个嵌入式机器人平台上的探测器-定位器推论。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • Visual cues for monocular 3D localization: a controlled analysis shows that visual features computed inside a frozen 2D pose detector retain distance-related information beyond coarse skeleton geometry. MoSoLoco incorporates these features with the detected 2D skeleton to estimate per-person 3D positions, without adding a separate image or depth encoder. • Multi-person spatial context: inspired by the value of inter-person context in human motion modeling, we investigate whether neighboring detections can also refine per-person monocular localization and introduce a sparse attention module that remains frame-based. • Empirical validation across settings: across JRDB and NuScenes with two detector capacities, MoSoLoco reduces localization error by up to 23.9% relative to the evaluated keypoint-based baselines. On JRDB, it matches or exceeds the accuracy of the much larger UniDepth and FCOS3D reference systems, while downstream forecasting and embedded-deployment studies assess its practical utility.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下: 单光三维本地化的视觉提示: 受控分析显示,在被冷冻的二维内所计算的视觉特征会保留粗骨架几何以外的相距信息. MoSoLoco将这些特性与被检测到的2D骨架相融合,以估计每人3D的位置,而无需添加单独的图像或深度编码器. ·多人空间上下文:受人间上下文在人类运动建模中的价值所启发,我们调查相邻的检测能否也精炼出人单体局部化,并引入一个仍然以帧为主的稀有关注模块. • 不同场合的经验验证:在JRDB和NuScenes两个探测器能力之间,MoSoLoco将本地化误差比评价的以关键点为基础的基线减少23.9%。 在JRDB上,它匹配或超过更大型的Uni Depth和FCOS3D参考系统的精度,而下游预测和嵌入式部署研究则评估其实用性.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Monocular 3D localization is commonly addressed through 3D object detection [ wang2021fcos3d , 9 , huang2022monodtr , 10 ] or metric-depth estimation [ 6 ] . These approaches provide general image-to-3D solutions but require a dedicated visual or depth network. The setting considered here is different: a human-centric perception stack already contains a 2D pose estimator, and the question is whether representations computed inside that estimator can also provide metric localization cues without introducing another image encoder.
blocks.zh: 单体3D本地化通常通过3D物体检测[wang2021fcos3d,9 ,huang2022monodtr,10]或测量深度估计[6]来解决. 这些方法提供了一般的图像到-3D解决方案,但需要专门的视觉或深度网络. 这里考虑的设置是不同的:一个以人为中心的感知堆已经包含一个2D的外观模型,而问题是,在其中计算出的表示是否也可以提供度量本地化提示而不引入另一个图像编码器.

blocks.en: Pose-based methods offer a lightweight alternative by exploiting human geometry. MonoLoco [ bertoni2019monoloco ] maps camera-normalized 2D skeletons to 3D locations, while MonStereo [ 1 ] and pose-aware localization methods [ 7 ] further exploit human priors and visibility cues. Chen et al. [ 3 ] complement skeleton-based localization with pseudo-LiDAR depth from an auxiliary image network, whereas MonoTransmotion [ luan2025unified ] uses temporal pose sequences to improve localization and trajectory prediction. MoSoLoco instead reuses joint-aligned features already computed by the pose detector and fuses them with skeleton geometry. It requires neither an additional depth/image network nor temporal observations, and it additionally investigates sparse same-frame multi-person context.
blocks.zh: 基于Pose的方法通过利用人类几何学提供了一种轻量级的替代方法. MonoLoco [bertoni2019monoloco]将相机常态化的2D骨架映射到3D位置,而MonStereo [1] 和外形感知本地化方法 [7] 进一步利用了人类的前身和能见度提示. 陈等. [3]用从辅助图像网络得到的伪LiDAR深度来补充基于骨架的本地化,而MonoTransmotion [luan2025unifined]则使用时间摆放序列来改进本地化和轨迹预测. MoSoLoco转而再利用由姿势探测器已经计算出来的联合相通特征,并用骨架几何来导出它们. 它既不需要额外的深度/图像网络,也不需要时间观察,它还对稀有的同框多人背景进行调查。

blocks.en: Human trajectory forecasting has evolved from recurrent social models [ alahi2016social ] to generative and attention-based approaches [ gupta2018social , ivanovic2020multimodal , saadatnejad2024socialtransmotion , 4 ] . The contribution here is not a new forecasting model. Forecasting serves as a controlled downstream evaluation of localization quality: fixed predictors and ground-truth association isolate whether improved per-frame 3D observations produce more useful observed trajectories.
blocks.zh: 人类的轨迹预测已经从反复出现的社会模型[alahi2016social]演变为以基因和关注为基础的方法[gupta2018social., ivanovic2020多式, saadatnejad2024 socialtransmotion., 4]. 这里的贡献不是一个新的预测模式。 预测是对本地化质量的一种可控下游评价:固定的预测器和地-地-地-地-地关联隔离了每帧3D观测得到改进后是否会产生更有用的可观察到的轨迹.

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: MoSoLoco estimates the metric 3D center of each detected person from a single frame while reusing representations already computed by the upstream pose estimator. As shown in Fig. 2 , each DETRPose [ janampa2025detrpose ] detection provides two complementary representations: explicit 2D skeleton geometry and joint-aligned decoder features available before keypoint regression. MoSoLoco fuses these representations into a person-level embedding and optionally refines it using sparse context from other people in the same frame. DETRPose remains frozen during localizer training, so no additional RGB or depth encoder is introduced.
blocks.zh: MoSoLoco从一个框架对每个被检测到的人的公尺3D中心进行估算,同时重用上游已计算出的表示值进行估计。 如图2所示,每个DETRPose [janampa2025detrpose]探测提供了两种互补的表示:显式2D骨架几何和键点回归前可用的联合相接解码器特征. MoSoLoco将这些表示物连接到人级嵌入物中,并可以选择地利用来自同一框架中其他人的稀疏上下文来完善. DETRPose在本地化器训练期间仍然被冻结,因此没有引入额外的RGB或深度编码器.

For each hypothesis, the center of its 2D skeleton is computed in the normalized camera plane and the k i = min ⁡ ( K , Q − 1 ) k_{i}=\min(K,Q-1) nearest external hypotheses are retained, where Q Q is the number of detected people. The person’s own token is included in the neighborhood.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: The experiments are organized around the central claim that a pose detector contains useful localization cues beyond its final joint coordinates. JRDB provides the main localization comparison and component analyses, NuScenes evaluates the approach in a second camera and scene domain, and controlled forecasting and embedded-deployment studies examine downstream value and practical use.
blocks.zh: 实验是围绕中心主张的,即姿势探测器在其最终联合坐标之外含有有用的局部化提示. JRDB提供主要本地化比较和组件分析,NuScenes在第二相机和场景域评价方法,并进行可控预测和嵌入式部署研究,检查下游价值和实际用途.

blocks.en: IV-A Localization Protocols
blocks.zh: IV-A 本地化协议

blocks.en: JRDB: The evaluation split contains 1,658 images and 3,422 annotated person-frame targets before filtering. MoSoLoco, MonoLoco [ bertoni2019monoloco ] , and MonoTransmotion [ luan2025unified ] are trained for 100 epochs with batch size 16 and learning rate 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} . Detector hypotheses are filtered at confidence 0.20 and pose-box NMS IoU 0.50, then matched to annotations using Hungarian assignment with minimum OKS 0.50. ADE is the mean Euclidean error between predicted and annotated pedestrian centers in the global ground plane over accepted matches. Coverage is the fraction of annotated targets retained by this policy. DETRPose-S retains 3,162/3,422 targets (92.40%), while DETRPose-N retains 2,794/3,422 (81.65%).
blocks.zh: JRDB:评价划分包含1,658个图像和3,422个附加注释的人物框架目标后再过滤. MosoLoco, MonoLoco [bertoni2019monoloco],和MonoTransmotion [luan2025unifed] 被训练给100个有批量大小的16个纪元,学习率5×10−4 5\times 10^{-4}. 探测器假说在0.20置信度和假放箱NMS IoU 0.50被过滤出,然后用匈牙利委派的至少OKS 0.50来配对为说明. ADE是全球地平面上预计和注解的行人中心之间平均欧几利得误差, 覆盖面是这项政策保留的说明性目标的一小部分。 DETRPose-S保留了3,162/3,422项目标(92.40%),而DETRPose-N保留了2,794/3,422项目标(81.65%)。

blocks.en: NuScenes: NuScenes does not provide human keypoints, so preprocessing follows MonoTransmotion [ luan2025unified ] . OpenPifPaf [ kreiss2019pifpaf ] produces pseudo poses in COCO-17 order that are associated with pedestrian annotations. DETRPose-S is initialized from its official COCO weights and its Transformer pose head is adapted for 10 epochs on pseudo poses from the official training scenes. Each localizer is then trained for 100 epochs on the same training scenes with fresh optimizer and scheduler states. Evaluation uses the official validation scenes, comprising 2,496 valid person-frame targets with mean and median camera-to-person distances of 16.13 m and 14.95 m. Confidence, NMS, and OKS thresholds match JRDB.
blocks.zh: 数值 : NuScenes不提供人的关键点,所以预处理跟随MonoTransmotion[luan2025unifed]. OpenPifPaf [kreiss2019pifpaf] 以COCO-17顺序出出与行人说明相联的伪相. DETRPose-S从其官方COCO的重量开始初始化,而其变形器的姿势头被改编为从官方训练场景起用假姿势的10个时代. 然后每个本地化器在同一个训练场景上为100个时代进行训练,有新鲜的优化器和调度器状态. 评价采用官方验证场景,由2 496个有效人框目标组成,中间相机对人距离为16.13米和14.95米。 信心,NMS,和OKS阈值相匹配的JRDB.

blocks.en: External systems: UniDepth V2 ViT-L [ 6 ] and FCOS3D R101 [ wang2021fcos3d ] provide broader reference points rather than controlled localizer ablations. On JRDB, frozen UniDepth uses DETRPose-S hypotheses and the same matching policy. Its calibrated variant applies a fixed per-camera ray correction estimated on the training split and a + 0.14 +0.14 m validation-selected depth offset; evaluation annotations are not used for calibration. FCOS3D is initialized from its official NuScenes-pretrained checkpoint and selected after one epoch of JRDB fine-tuning. On NuScenes, UniDepth again uses DETRPose-S hypotheses, whereas FCOS3D performs its own detection. Because detection, training, and depth-processing pipelines differ, these systems are reported as contextual accuracy–resource comparisons rather than parameter-matched ablations.
blocks.zh: 外接系统:Uni Depth V2 ViT-L [6]和FCOS3D R101 [wang2021fcos3d]提供更广泛的参考点,而不是被控制的本地化器活化. 在JRDB上,被冻结的Uni Depth使用了DETRPose-S假说和相同的匹配策略. 其校正变体采用在训练分解上估计的固定每相机射线校正,并使用+0.14+0.14米的验证-选取深度相抵;评价说明不用于校正. FCOS3D从其官方的NuScenes预训检查站被初始化,经过一个时代的JRDB微调后被选中. 在NuScenes上,Uni Depth再次使用DETRPose-S假说,而FCOS3D进行自己的检测. 由于检测、培训和深度处理管道不同,这些系统被报告为背景精确度-资源比较,而不是参数相匹配的比对。

blocks.en: Resource measurements: FP32 inference costs are measured on an NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB at batch size one. Peak memory is the maximum torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated over three forward passes after two warm-up passes and includes parameters, inputs, activations, outputs, and temporary PyTorch allocations. GFLOPs are measured from the executed graph with CalFlops. Learned localizers use Q = 5 Q=5 people per image, 17 joints, 128-dimensional detector latents, and K = 4 K=4 unless stated otherwise. DETRPose uses 640 × 640 640\times 640 input, and the shared detector cost is listed separately from each localizer.
blocks.zh: 资源测量:FP32推论成本在一号批量大小的NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB上进行测量. 峰值记忆是最高火炬.cuda.max_memory_在两次取暖后分出三个前行通道,包括参数,输入,活化,输出,以及临时PyTorch分配. GFLOP是用 CalFlops 执行的图来测量的. 学习的本地化器使用Q=每张图像有5个Q=5人,有17个关节,128维探测器潜伏,K=4个K=4,除非另有说明. DETRPose使用640×640 640\times 640输入,共享探测器成本与每个本地化器分别列出.

blocks.en: IV-B Controlled Forecasting Protocol
blocks.zh: IV-B 受控预测议定书

blocks.en: Trajectories are sampled at 2.5 Hz. Each example contains eight observation slots (3.2 s), of which two to eight may contain accepted localizer predictions, followed by 12 prediction frames (4.8 s). The Vanilla Transformer and OmniTraj [ 4 ] are each trained once using only ground-truth locations and identities, with batch size 16 and learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} . At evaluation time, every localizer is paired with the same trained forecaster and the same ground-truth future trajectories.
blocks.zh: 轨迹以2.5Hz为样本. 每个实例包含8个观测槽(3.2 s),其中2到8个可能包含被接受的地心分解器预测,后有12个预测帧(4.8 s). 香草变形器和OmniTraj [4] 每人只使用地上真实位置和身份接受过一次训练,批量尺寸为16,学习率为10 - 4 10 - 4。 在评估时,每个本地化器都配有相同的训练有素的预报器和相同的地-真实未来轨迹.

blocks.en: Ground-truth identities are used only as an offline association control. In each observed frame, post-filtering pose detections are assigned one-to-one to ground-truth people by Hungarian keypoint matching, and only matches satisfying the OKS threshold are retained. Accepted detections inherit the corresponding identity for this experiment; rejected detections remain missing and are represented with a zero temporal mask. A window is scored when the final observed frame is valid and at least two of the eight observation slots are valid. Methods are compared on the intersection of retained windows within each detector condition.
blocks.zh: 地面真实身份仅用作离线关联控制. 在每个被观测到的框架中,通过匈牙利键点比对,将过滤后姿势检测分配到地上真人一对一,只保留符合OKS阈值的匹配. 接受检测会继承此实验的相应身份;被拒绝的检测仍然缺失并被以零时间口罩表示. 当最终被观测到的帧有效且8个观察槽中至少有2个有效时,窗口被打入. 对每个探测器条件下保留窗口的相接点进行方法比较。

blocks.en: Forecasting ADE is the mean ground-plane error over the 12 future steps and FDE is the error at the final future step. OmniTraj uses best-of-20 minimum ADE and the FDE from the same ADE-selected mode. The DETRPose-S common cohort retains 1,277 of 1,349 forecast-scored ground-truth-eligible trajectories (94.66%) across 631 cache scenes. DETRPose-N retains 1,054 trajectories across 568 cache scenes (78.13%). Coverage is reported with ADE/FDE because missed or rejected observations are not assigned zero displacement error.
blocks.zh: 预测ADE是未来12个步骤的地上飞机平均出错,FDE是未来最后一步的错误. OmniTraj使用最佳20个最低ADE和来自同一种ADE选取模式的FDE. DETRPose-S共同组群保留了631个缓存场景中1 277个1 349个预测分数的地面真相合格轨迹(94.66%)。 DETRPose-N保留了1 054个轨迹,跨越了568个缓存场景(78.13%). 使用ADE/FDE报告覆盖范围,因为遗漏或拒绝的观测结果没有分配到零移位错误。

blocks.en: For the filtered-history condition, only the observed prefix is processed with a second-order forward–backward Butterworth filter ( W n = 1 / 6 W_{n}=1/6 ). Missing slots are interpolated only for filtering and restored to missing afterward; masks and future coordinates remain unchanged. The filter therefore uses no information after the forecast origin.
blocks.zh: 对于被过滤的历史条件,只有被观测到的前缀用二等前置-后置巴特沃斯滤波器(Wn = 1/6 W_{n}=1/6)处理. 缺失的插槽仅用于过滤并恢复后缺失;口罩和未来坐标保持不变. 因此,过滤器在预测来源后没有使用任何信息.

blocks.en: IV-C Embedded Deployment Protocol
blocks.zh: 四-C 内嵌部署议定书

blocks.en: DETRPose-S with the Transformer and MLP social localizers ( K = 4 K=4 ) is evaluated on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier using JetPack 5.1.2, TensorRT 8.5.2, batch size one, and 640 × 640 640\times 640 inputs. The board runs in 30 W all-core mode with fixed CPU, GPU, and memory clocks. The baseline uses PyTorch FP32. The optimized implementation uses a mixed FP16/FP32 TensorRT detector, FP32 TensorRT localizers, reused TensorRT buffers, and an exact stable-greedy CUDA NMS kernel. Both runtimes use identical checkpoint weights and the same 1,658-image JRDB evaluation payload.
blocks.zh: 使用JetPack 5.1.2,TensorRT 8.5.2,批量尺寸一和640×640 640\times 640投入,对带有变形器和MLP社会本地化器的DETRPose-S(K = 4 K=4)进行NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上的评价. 该板以30W全核模式运行,并有固定的CPU,GPU,和内存时钟. 基线使用PyTorch FP32. 优化后的实施使用混合的FP16/FP32 TensorRT探测器,FP32 TensorRT本地化器,再用TensorRT缓冲器,以及精确稳定的CUDA NMS内核. 两个运行时间都使用相同的检查站重量和相同的1,658-图像JRDB评价有效载荷.

blocks.en: Latency is measured with CUDA synchronization around each forward pass; the first 10 images are excluded as warm-up. The timed region contains DETRPose inference, confidence filtering, NMS, and localization. Image loading and resizing, host-to-device transfer, and final metric post-processing are excluded. Reported FPS therefore measures detector–localizer model inference rather than full sensor-to-output system throughput.
blocks.zh: 纬度用CUDA的同步来测量每个前行通道周围;前10个图像作为取暖被排除在外. 定时区域包含DETRPose推论,信心过滤,NMS,以及本地化. 图像加载和再大小,主机到设备传输,以及最后的度量后处理不包括在内. 因此,报告过的FPS衡量探测器-定位器模型推论,而不是完整的传感器对输出系统吞吐量。

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: The central result is that intermediate pose-detector representations improve a lightweight pose-based monocular localizer when fused with camera-normalized skeleton geometry. The gain appears with both DETRPose-S and DETRPose-N on JRDB and remains present on NuScenes after dataset-specific pose adaptation and localizer training. The latent-only ablation is also informative: detector features can support localization by themselves with DETRPose-S, but not consistently with DETRPose-N, while the combined models outperform their latent-only counterparts for both detector capacities. Together with the feature probe, these results are consistent with the reused representations carrying localization-relevant information that complements the final 2D keypoints; they do not identify which visual cues are responsible.
blocks.zh: 中心结果是中间姿势探测器在被相机常态化的骨架几何相接上后,能改进一种轻量级姿势基的单相机定位器. 该增益出现在JRDB上的DETRPose-S和DETRPose-N上,并在针对数据集的适应和本地化培训后仍然出现在NuScens上. 仅以潜伏为主的膨胀也具有信息性:探测器特性可自行支持DETRPose-S的本地化,但不能与DETRPose-N一致,而综合模型在两种探测器能力上都超过了其仅以潜伏为主的对应器. 这些结果与特征探针一起,与带有本地化相关信息的再利用表示是一致的,这些信息是对最后2D关键点的补充;它们没有识别哪个视觉提示负责.

blocks.en: Same-frame multi-person attention provides an additional but smaller refinement. Its point estimate improves for both MLP and Transformer localizers and for every tested value of K K relative to the no-social setting. The non-monotonic neighborhood ablation and the qualitative cases in Fig. 3 indicate, however, that neighboring hypotheses are not uniformly useful. The failure example is consistent with context becoming less reliable when the anchor differs strongly from surrounding upright pedestrians, whereas context can help when the anchor itself is heavily truncated. This motivates compatibility-aware aggregation using pose, visibility, or activity-related cues rather than assuming that more neighbors will always help.
blocks.zh: 同帧多人关注提供了额外的但更小的改进. 相对于无社会环境,它的分数估计对MLP和变形器本地化器和KK的每个测试值都有改善。 然而,图3中的非情绪化邻里衰减和定性案例表明,相邻的假说并不一致。 失败的例子与下述情况相一致:当锚与周围直立行人有很大差异时,上下文变得不那么可靠;而当锚本身被严重截断时,上下文可以有所帮助。 这激发了使用姿势、能见度或活动相关提示的兼容意识聚合,而不是假设更多的邻居总是会有所帮助。

blocks.en: The forecasting experiment evaluates downstream utility under deliberately controlled association. MoSoLoco observations yield lower forecasting ADE than the pose-based localization baselines for both a deterministic Transformer and OmniTraj, while the ground-truth-history rows remain substantially below every predicted-history condition. The result is consistent with localization quality being an important source of downstream forecasting error in the evaluated setting. It is not an end-to-end tracking result: identities are supplied through ground-truth association, failed detections remain masked, and forecasting metrics are computed on a common retained cohort. Per-frame and forecast-window coverage therefore remain necessary companion metrics when interpreting ADE and FDE.
blocks.zh: 预测实验在有意控制的关联下评价下游的效用. MoSoLoco观测结果的预测ADE低于确定变形器和OmniTraj的定位基线,而地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地) 其结果与本地化质量是评价环境中下游预报出错的重要来源相一致. 这不是一个端到端跟踪结果:身份是通过地面真实关联提供的,失败的检测仍然被掩盖,预测指标是在一个共同的保留组中计算的。 因此,在解释ADE和FDE时,每个框架和预测窗口的覆盖面仍然是必要的配套指标。

blocks.en: Several limitations bound the claims. First, NuScenes is not a zero-shot transfer experiment because both the pose front end and localizers use the NuScenes training scenes before validation. Second, UniDepth and FCOS3D follow different detection and processing pipelines and obtain lower ADE than MoSoLoco on NuScenes; those rows therefore quantify an accuracy–compute trade-off rather than a controlled accuracy comparison. Third, the tables report point estimates without repeated-seed uncertainty, so small differences, including the few-centimeter social gains and the gap between the two MoSoLoco backbones, should be interpreted cautiously. Finally, Jetson measurements exclude image preprocessing, host-to-device transfer, and final post-processing. The reported 23–24 FPS is detector–localizer model-inference throughput, not full sensor-to-output latency.
blocks.zh: 若干限制对索赔具有约束力。 首先, NuScenes并不是零发转录实验,因为姿势前端和本地化者在验证前都使用NuScenes训练场景. 第二,Uni Depth和FCOS3D遵循不同的检测和处理管道,在NuScenes上获得比MoSoLoco更低的ADE;因此,这些行量化了精确度-计算取舍而不是控制性精确度比较。 第三,表格报告点数估计数时没有重复的种子不确定性,因此,应该谨慎地解释小的差别,包括几厘米的社会收益和两个MoSoLoco骨干之间的差距。 最后,杰特森测量排除了图像预处理,主机到设备的传输,以及最后的后处理. 所报告的23至24个FPS是探测器-定位器模型-推导通量,而不是完全的传感器对输出时空。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en:
This work introduced MoSoLoco , a lightweight per-frame approach to monocular 3D human localization that reuses intermediate visual representations from a
frozen 2D pose detector. MoSoLoco combines these representations with skeleton geometry, while a sparse same-frame interaction module uses nearby detections to
further refine each estimate. The feature analysis showed that the detector representations retain depth-related structure beyond coarse skeleton cues, providing
empirical support for their use in localization.
